questions.question_text:
The height of a plant increases by $150\%$.
The original height was $70$ cm.
Ravi multiplies by $1.5$ and gets $105$ cm.
What is the correct new height?

options.text: $175$ cm; increasing by $150\%$ means multiplying by $2.5$.

options.why: Treated $150\%$ as the whole multiplier, forgetting to add the original $100\%$.

questions.question_text:
Daisy’s weight was $650\,\text{kg}$.
Her weight has increased by $17\%$.
Calculate Daisy’s new weight.

options.why: Adds 17 kg instead of increasing by 17 percent.
Adds 126 kg, corresponding to an excessive percentage increase.

questions.solution_text: A 17% increase multiplies the original by $1.17$. Thus $650\times1.17=760.5\,\text{kg}$.
